Place the six wave-8 Con(ZFC) Diophantine packages beside waves 5-7 (batch 224)

Arrival 7331974b69 ("Con(ZFC) in Diophantine form (wave-8)") delivered six
archives. Following Vladimir's standing direction for this report, no
earlier wave is deleted: the packages land as sources 54-59 of
Computability/DiophantineConsistency/con-zfc-diophantine-forms, next to
waves 5-7 (31-53).

- 54-calibrated-carry   con-zfc-calibrated-carry-4b4349064a.zip
- 55-congruence-norms   con_zfc_congruence_norms_2026-10-23.zip
- 56-free-coordinate    ConZFC_Free_Coordinate_2026-10-23.zip
- 57-separated-degrees  ConZFC_Separated_Degrees_2026-10-23.zip
- 58-integral-root      ConZFC_Integral_Root_2026-10-23.zip
- 59-degree-separated   ZFC_Diophantine_Degree_Separated_2026-10-23.zip

Each archive is extracted straight from the committed ZIP with its single
wrapper directory removed. Of 1,736 members, 974 are staged, 759 are
omitted as byte copies (up to line ends) of files already in the tree,
mostly the wave-5 to wave-7 sources they bundle, and 3 SHA256SUMS ledgers
are git-ignored. Licence, notice and attribution files are always kept.
The recovery map is appended to PLACEMENT.md as the batch-224 record.

All six ZIPs are retired from docs/incoming. Nothing was edited or run.

Formalize the literal package 52 quadratic source, bounds, ratio substitution and finalizer

Check all 60 source gates, 22 positive-domain residuals, 136 shifted
coefficient records and 71 active pairs over arbitrary coefficient ports.
Pin the original source JSON and reproduce the Lean output with an
independent standard-library coefficient expansion and SHA checks.

Prove the selective kernel has exact degree 7516 and leading coefficient
two, its product has degree below 7865, and every selected coefficient is
twice the corresponding literal source row. Establish sharp corrected
coefficient height 4BK, specializing to the published 2^1182955 bound
without squaring the transport port. Add generic convolution, half-base,
pre-decoding positivity/range and two-block central-binomial lemmas.

Formalize arbitrary-position low-mask decoding, including the actual
weight-zero input and excluded dummy weight 81. Prove sharp sparse-code
completeness bounds, source-zero code positivity, exact power-of-two
scales and explicit cofinal witness bounds. Instantiate the exact H
reparameterization against the existing Jones numerical ratio theorem.
Prove package 52's actual margin-first finalizer and derive its majorants
and separation from the concrete arithmetic identities.

Document these checked stages while keeping the assembled source adapter,
actual native-port calibration, closed replacement equation and internal
ZFC equivalence explicitly open. Preserve the existing certified baseline.

Validation: standard Lake umbrella build PASS (3709 jobs); refreshed
umbrella import and new component regression/axiom files PASS; completed
audits use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Source generator
reproduces the checked Lean file byte-for-byte; git diff --check passes.

Review wave seven proposals and redirect the small equation target to selective quadratic packing

Review all eight new packages, replay the original release archives, and independently count and compare 38 literal circuits. Select package 52 interior regular as the next nine-variable target: 548 positive-domain operations and degree 15,502,748, retaining its two lower-degree tradeoffs and package 53 calibrated degree-7,344,328 alternative. Record exact domains, whole coefficient bindings, Python gzip portability failures, and inherited proof obligations.

Prove support-sensitive simultaneous quadratic extraction for arbitrary weights and targets. Kernel-check the literal package-46 and package-52 active-pair certificates, allowing unused collisions, and prove regular-target extraction for all coefficient families on the package-52 support. Formalize the sharp near-square majorant and exact one-witness finalizer equivalence, plus package-47 ordinary strong minimum-norm finalizers.

Compute bounds and universal closure for arbitrary internal formula codes, prove exact sealF quotation and actual ZFC totality/functionality statements, and supply a sealed-axiom consistency sentence with exact arbitrary-model semantics. The full internal consistency versus polynomial equivalence remains open.

Reduce the checked native enumerator step from 1,811 to 1,742 witnesses using one-slack disequality and direct output retention; preserve the 6,924-witness baseline. Add checked size folds for the bounded universal compiler without expanding its syntax.

Reduce native enumerator graphs and formalize simultaneous quadratic carry and internal equation syntax

Retain the existing output coordinate in graph composition and replace fixed native formula blocks by literal polynomial graphs. The checked one-step witness count drops from 6,924 to 1,811; NativeZFC now instantiates that representation while retaining the unconditional external consistency equivalence.

Add simultaneous quadratic coefficient extraction and its exact signed carry/central-binomial test, with support bounds and regression checks. These are foundations for a smaller Jones adapter rather than a claim of a new closed equation.

Formalize internal multiplication, NatExpr evaluation, the actual polynomial unsolvability sentence, an unbounded consistency sentence for the canonical unsealed axiom coding, and universal-closure iteration on internal formula codes. Prove exact arbitrary-model semantics and available object-language totality/functionality implications; document the remaining internal refutation and MRDP/Jones transfer obligations.

certificate DAGs in 45; every package disclaims a consistency proof

restored; 41 and 39 credited in the questions; the BusyBeaver pointer

README.md and STATUS.md, which still say "wave-5 report collection".

Add direct arithmetic and positive-domain consistency equations with quadratic coding foundations

Close NativeZFC from the exact native arithmetic graph of haltingTest, using direct quadratic Cantor relations, explicit equality branches, and a specialized outer iteration trace. Prove its unconditional nine-natural and nine-positive unsolvability equivalences and solvability agreement with ExplicitZFC. Add the exact positive-coordinate shift and its ordinary polynomial correctness theorem.

Share packed gate and axiom-stack arguments in the scalar checker, reducing its code from 31,889 to 14,751 nodes (14,323 optimized), preserving the exact specification. Supply zero-witness graph constructors for natural polynomials and fixed-positive-denominator polynomials, including closure under Cantor pairing.

Prove explicit cubic-size Sidon positions and generic quadratic coefficient extraction, with diagonal/off-diagonal and zero-dimensional regressions. These foundations do not yet replace the final Jones theorem. Begin the separate internal ZFC obligation with actual addition formulas, arbitrary-model semantics, and BProv derivations of addition totality and uniqueness; document the remaining nonstandard-model and consistency-coding gaps.

Record a reproducible residual-shear search and its limited ordinary degree obstruction, without claiming a new frontier point. Reconcile the merged wave-6 catalogue by removing the temporary duplicate notice and correct two displayed formula-coordinate mappings found in independent review.

Validation: standard Lake umbrella build (3670 jobs); consolidated compiler/ZFC and object-addition axiom audits; Sidon/quadratic regressions; exact symbolic shear search. All audited theorem dependencies remain within propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Full native-source size comparison and internal consistency equivalence remain open.
